title: Kissed Jamaican Amaretti Fritters
description: Pungent, fluffy, crowd-pleasing Jamaican fried treats featuring amaretti, air-fried, and fodmap-friendly, perfect as a dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: amaretti cookies
ingredients.notes: crushed, chopped or ground works as well

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine almond flour, crushed amaretti cookies, coconut sugar, salt, and spices.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, coconut milk, and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Cover the dough and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C).
Line the air fryer basket with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Using a small cookie scoop or spoon, drop small balls of dough onto the prepared basket.
Gently flatten the dough balls slightly with your fingers or the back of a spoon.
Sprinkle toasted coconut flakes over the tops of the fritters.
Air fry the fritters for 8-10 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove from the air fryer and let cool slightly on a wire rack.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar, and enjoy!
Store leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
When ready to serve, simply thaw and reheat in a toaster oven or air fryer until crispy and warm.
Note: To make ahead, assemble the dough and refrigerate up to 24 hours before air frying.
To make a double batch, simply double all ingredients and adjust air fryer cooking time as needed.
To make these fritters gluten-free, be sure to use gluten-free almond flour and check the ingredients of the amaretti cookies for gluten.
To make these fritters dairy-free, substitute coconut milk with your preferred non-dairy milk and be mindful of the amaretti cookies' ingredients.
Don't overcrowd the air fryer basket for even cooking, cook in batches if necessary.
Use a thermometer to ensure the air fryer reaches the correct temperature for crispy fritters.
If using a convection oven, bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Make sure to not overmix the dough to prevent tough fritters.
Use a parchment-lined baking sheet to bake in a conventional oven if air frying is not an option.
Don't overbake or underbake the fritters, aim for a golden brown color and crispy exterior.
